chapter_notes: Review-style chapter with no quantitative potency data (only in vivo doses, 5 records have doses). Skipped 3 statements whose target is neither receptor nor enzyme (ethanol inhibiting facilitated-diffusion/ENT1 transporters on PDF 722, ethanol altering chloride conductance via GABAA on PDF 722, and acute ethanol inhibiting ENT1 on PDF 726). Receptors that are really ligand-gated channels (P2X, 5-HT3, glycine, benzodiazepine/GABAA) were kept as receptors because the book calls them receptors; they are flagged in notes and may be dropped later.
